description: This file defines the RecruitmentAttachmentService class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It manages attachment file types and interacts with the RecruitmentAttachmentDao for database operations related to recruitment attachments.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentService
classes.description: Provides services related to recruitment attachment handling, including defining allowed file types and accessing the associated DAO.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachmentDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of RecruitmentAttachmentDao used by this service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RecruitmentAttachmentService and its DAO.
